name: universalmods
description: Local web floor that runs a team of Codex or Claude Code agents in live terminals, with a master orchestrator and Claude-Code-style hot-reloading mods. This plugin adds a skill to install, run and drive a floor and to write mods.

interface.shortDescription: Run a team of coding agents in live terminals. Mod everything.
interface.longDescription: universalMods is a local web floor where a master Orchestrator plans and delegates to Codex or Claude Code agents, each running its real CLI in a live browser terminal, sharing a kanban, plan board and messages. Every view, guard and agent tool is a hot-reloading mod. The bundled skill helps your agent install and start a floor, drive it over its HTTP API, and write mods.
defaultPrompt: Set up universalMods in this machine and start a Claude floor.
Write a universalMods mod that shows tokens per agent as a bar chart.
